study: PHASE1 Prototype 1: M2 joint hypothesis-membership revision vs B1/B2
dataset: QuebecTrees (canopyrs prepared); train 148 tiles x 4 quadrants; validation 139 crops; TEST not touched
base_model: Mask R-CNN s42, validation-selected checkpoint, frozen; candidates score >= 0.45
features: FPN level 0 (stride 4, 256 ch), RoIAlign 32x32, RoI = mask box x1.25, min side 24
training_set: all REFORM + KEEP sampled with p=0.26 (seeded by crop index); no synthetic unions
augmentation: dihedral (rot90 x flip), identical across arms per batch
decision_threshold: 0.5 after prior correction from cache ratio to natural train KEEP/REFORM prior
